title: Chapter 677
paragraphs: Chapter 677
Episode 173. Pursuing the Sword (2)
On an uninhabited island in the Tikan Sea.
Jin chose this place to open the sixth tomb, the void space of the sword.
Jin, the strong ones of Tikan, and the owner of the sword, Hedo and Sandra, took their positions in the middle of the uninhabited island in case of an emergency.
"Are we going to open the void space by spreading out your spiritual energy like last time?"
"It should be more like infusing it into the sword."
"Hmm."
Hedo adjusted his glasses with an unconvinced expression.
"In Calderan Snowfield, you said that the location had to meet certain conditions for Temar's tomb to open, Twelve Knights. I don't think this uninhabited island fits that requirement."
"Not all tombs were like that. Back then, we only made assumptions due to the sudden circumstances."
Hedo shrugged his shoulders and handed the sword to Jin.
As Jin received the sword, he gave a sly smile to Hedo.
"Don't you feel it's fateful, Tower Keeper?"
"What are you talking about all of a sudden?"
"I just thought, wasn't it just a coincidence that you obtained this sword after a thousand years. The combination of the old ten knights and Zipfel's servant, isn't it?"
"That's a pointless argument about fate."
"I just want to persuade you by bringing up such pointless fate. Perhaps, you might be a descendant of the ten knights named Bale. So the sword found you. It's not a coincidence."
"That's a romantic story, dear."
"Miss, it's not romantic at all."
"Why does our foolish servant think like that?"
"When the Family first took me in, they verified all my background, you know?"
"Ah, those wretched ones who abandoned Hedo. I remember them, though I couldn't see their faces because they're already dead."

"Did you hear that, Twelve Knights? My parents were insignificant commoners and criminals. They would abandon their child because they couldn't handle it, occasionally visited the orphanage out of guilt, but never took back their child. When their guilt became bearable, they stopped visiting, they were such criminals."
Even while saying such things, Hedo seemed to show no change in his feelings.
In fact, he didn't feel anything special towards his parents who abandoned him as soon as he was born. He never missed them, nor did he hate them.
"Moreover, the Family verified their roots, and it turned out they were from a merchant family of the extinct Urot Kingdom. Meaning, whoever is in the sword, he can't be my ancestor."
"What a pity."
"It seems not only Miss but also you need to learn the mysterious art of push and pull. If you rush at me so desperately, it would only make me less interested, wouldn't it?"
"Take note of that."
Jin seemingly disappointed, replied with a sly grin.
Hedo, for some reason, found his behavior sneaky and thought he should have beaten him up more back in the Sota desert.
Soon, Jin changed his expression and looked around at the people.
"From now on, I will inject Qi into the sword. It would be great if the tomb opens smoothly, but since we don't know what variables might occur, everyone please stay alert."
"Yes, my lord!"
"Understood, my lord."
As Jin released his Qi, the area quickly began to darken.
Despite it being broad daylight, it seemed as if night had fallen all at once, and the dazzling sunlight was obscured by a black curtain.
'As expected, a large amount of Qi is needed this time too.'
He was somewhat nervous, perhaps because of the memory of the last tomb, where he entered nearly depleted of Qi and fought a strenuous battle against Luntia.
Also, he could face a burdensome opponent while all his Qi was exhausted.
Above all, there was a high possibility that a living figure from ancient Runcandel exists within this sword.
He, too, could attack Jin out of the blue, like the tomb guardians he has met so far, and if he was one of the Ten Great Knights, he would not be weaker than Luntia.
'A living member of ancient Runcandel...'

It could have been possible because the A-Space is a 'dead world', or because they are beings with thousands of years of lifespan like dragons or demons. He had never received information that all the Ten Great Knights were human.
'Or it could be in a sealed state, like Elona Zipfel.'
The Qi kept spreading endlessly. Every now and then it was absorbed by the sword, and those who watched couldn't even gauge the size of the Qi that Jin was controlling.

'It reminds me of the release of Qi that Murakan in his prime showed. That stupid guy seems to have found his strength, but can't help Jin as he is substituting for Misha... It would be reassuring if he was here at a time like this.'
In the Calderan Snowfield, the tomb rejected anyone other than Jin.
Although there was an experience where the entire party entered the tomb and confronted the guardian Sarah, Quikantel was hoping that it could be the same this time.
A while passed like that.
'Qi is being injected like crazy, but there doesn't seem to be any sign of something changing from the sword...'
At this rate, the Qi will soon be exhausted, but Hedo's sword remained unmoved.
It didn't radiate light or form a door like it did in the Calderan Snowfield.
"Mr. Jin, it feels different from last time. Did the redhead bring some wrong information?"
Sandra stared at Valeria and said.
Valeria did not react and quietly watched Jin and the sword.
"Do we have to find out how to open the door of the sword again through record magic if it fails like this? Things like location conditions."
"In my opinion, the redhead is completely wrong, Hedo. It's strange from the beginning that an ancient living Runcandel is in the sword."
"I also find it strange."
"Uh, but if what the redhead said is all true, and the door suddenly opens. What if that Runcandel attacks Mr. Jin? Just like in the Calderan Snowfield."
"Wouldn't the problem for you, miss, be if that ancient Runcandel becomes an ally of the 12th batch?"
"Wish what you want to, Hedo. That would be a good thing for Mr. Jin, how could I worry about that?"
"I've lost my roots and family to you people, and I've been chased for a long time."
Valeria said in a low voice, not even looking at Sandra.
"What did you say, redhead?"
"I mean shut up and focus on the work because I feel like killing you. We're all here because we have to work."
Valeria still did not look at Sandra, but Sandra blinked her eyes at the chilly killing intent contained in that low voice.
And the moment Sandra was about to yell...
Suddenly, Hedo's sword began to change for the first time, vibrating.
"Is the A-Space about to open?"
"Luckily, it seems that no other problems will occur..."
Quikantel cut off his words.
Because he saw Jin's expression.
"Jin, are you okay?"
"Jin!?"
The normally expressionless Jin's face was full of confusion.
The reason was none other than this.
'The Keeper's sword seems to be ready to spring somewhere...!'
Since Jin was directly injecting Qi, he was more aware than anyone else of the change that had begun in the sword.
And according to what he felt, Hedo's sword seemed to have chosen to 'move' instead of opening a door like last time.
Before 3 seconds passed, Jin was certain. That the sword was about to spring somewhere soon.
He tried to stop the Qi from flowing into the sword, but the sword had already obtained enough power to move.
Whoosh, Thwack-!
Like a magic cannon being fired.
Suddenly, the sword that was in front of Jin tore through the black curtain that covered the sky and shot into the sky.
It looked as if it was launching Runcandel's secret technique, Light Speed Thrust, into the sky.
Space distorted due to the speed of the flying sword, and everyone gathered on the island looked up at the sky.
"Uh, Hedo's sword popped like a firecracker...!"
Hedo jumping up in a flash.
He landed on the ground, unable to grasp his sword.
Looking at the further distanced sword, Hedo could only make a dumbfounded expression.
"Catch it!"
Quikantel shouted.
However, the sword that had shot up linearly was already changing direction and flying somewhere.
The Qi from Jin that the sword absorbed even left a long trail in the sky like a comet's tail.
In the blink of an eye, the sword was more than a mile away from those gathered.
Instinctively, Jin assumed that the sword was flying to find a space to open his A-space.
If so, the opening of the tomb would be successful, but it wasn't a good situation.
It was that there was no means to chase that sword immediately.

The Red Owl was standing by towards Moomyung, Mort was injured, and even if they were there in the first place, it would be difficult to chase a sword in that state. The sword is not space moving, but pure hypersonic flight.
Everyone watching the sword now had no memory of seeing a flying object moving faster than that.
"Mr. Quikantel!"
Jin called Quikantel. Because he had to chase the sword.
"Got it!"
Quikantel quickly manifested the power of time and transformed into her original form.
However, the sword was just barely escaping the power of time and moving far into the sky.
Those who had gathered climbed onto Quikantel's back smoothly.
Quikantel started flying at full speed, but it was too much to catch up with the sword.
[Follow at least the traces of Qi left by the sword!]
Fortunately, Hedo's sword was moving forward, leaving a long trail of Qi like a contrail.
The sword was already too far away to be seen, but if they followed the trace, they should be able to reach the sword's destination.
The problem was that they didn't know where the destination was and if the sword's flight was getting longer.

'This is an entirely unexpected situation. I thought if there was a problem with the opening of the tomb, it would naturally be a battle with the tomb guardian, but who would have thought the sword would fly like that!'
And leaving so many traces.
The fact that the sword was flying for a long time, leaving traces all over the sky, means that this situation can be exposed to any force other than Ticany.
If by the time they reach the sword's destination, forces like the Sword's Garden, Zipfel, Kinzelo, and the Royal Family are all gathered there.
'The temporary allies would be hesitant to make a fuss, but not the Sword's Garden...!'
At the drop of a hat, a picture of the giant forces gathering at the sixth tomb of Temar could emerge.
Hedo's murderous gaze landed on Jin's back.
"It looks like this is an issue you hadn't anticipated at all. But if this situation leads me to lose my sword, it won't be very enjoyable. 12th batch..."
